flagged.evidence: The formula applies w₂ to I₂(K), but the Kontsevich definition places I₂(K) in the complexified chord module. The universal theorem explicitly says to “Extend each rational weight system complex-linearly to the complexified chord-diagram module.” The Example does not define that extension, so the displayed domains do not compose as written.
